business_problem: Petoro needed to improve mature-field development and well placement decisions on the Norwegian Continental Shelf while dealing with more than 1,000 sidetrack opportunities per field, low-quality data, and no unified collaboration workflow between drilling and reservoir engineering teams.
solution_summary: Petoro used AI embedded in digital solutions from SLB to speed mature-field development and optimize well placement. The source describes an implementation centered on bringing mature-field opportunity data and reservoir context into a shared digital workflow, where AI and analytics evaluate very large sets of sidetrack options that had previously been handled manually. Within that environment, the solution generates probabilistic well rankings to highlight low-performing wells, creates probability maps to improve understanding of overall reservoir performance, and applies analytics-based optimization to target large, connected, highly saturated oil volumes. Reservoir engineers can then generate hundreds more geological scenario realizations in far less time, while drilling and reservoir teams work from a more unified decision process. The source does not name a separate storage product, but it clearly positions SLB’s digital solution layer as the system where data extraction, scenario generation, optimization, and decision support are operationalized.
